recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.(debug|release)/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s.\^?([0-9.]+).\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
cp tool/pubspec_overrides.floss.yaml pubspec_overrides.yaml
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/dart run slang
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --flavor floss --target-platform android-arm64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/apk/floss/release/app-floss-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
